build.beforeBuildCommand: npm run tauri:sync && npm run build

security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'
security.devCsp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost http://localhost:1420 ws://localhost:1420; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'

bundle.shortDescription: Desktop client for the Hermes Agent Iroh-channel plugin
bundle.longDescription: A desktop client that connects directly to a Hermes Agent server over Iroh and streams responses into a local chat UI.
